name: Rio
source:
Rio is the protagonist of the game Tokyo Ghoul: Jail.
Imprisoned on suspicion of being the ghoul known as Jail (ジェイル), he escapes from Cochlea and hunts for the real culprit. 

[From [url=http://tokyoghoul.wikia.com/wiki/Rio_(game)#cite_note-Rio_Character_Profile-0]Tokyo Ghoul Wikia[/url]]
